items.title: Amalfi Coast Slow Days
items.heroDescription: Six unhurried days between Positano and Ravello, with a private boat morning and a terrace dinner above the Tyrrhenian Sea.
items.summary: A slow coastal week of terraced gardens, boat mornings and long lunches, staying in family-run hotels with sea-facing rooms.
highlights: Private gozzo boat along the coast at sunrise
Path of the Gods walk with a local guide

items.title: Alpine Peaks & Lakes
items.heroTitle: High passes, still lakes, clean air.
items.heroDescription: Five nights in the Valais with railway journeys, ridge walks and a lakeside village base — all by train, no hire car needed.
items.summary: Rail-first mountain days: glacier viewpoints, mountain huts and quiet trails, with luggage moved for you each morning.
highlights: Scenic rail journey to a glacier viewpoint
Guided ridge walk with a mountain guide

items.title: Santorini Caldera Sunsets
items.heroTitle: White walls, blue domes, gold evenings.
items.heroDescription: Caldera-view rooms in Oia, a catamaran afternoon and a wine evening in Pyrgos — timed around the quiet hours.
items.summary: Five nights above the caldera with cliff-path walks, a sailing afternoon and a sunset table in a village taverna.

items.title: Lake Como Private Shores
items.heroTitle: Villas, water, and very little else.
items.heroDescription: Four calm days on the lake with a wooden-boat crossing, garden visits and dinners in Bellagio's back streets.
items.summary: A short, restorative lake break: villa gardens, a private boat crossing and long dinners with the water in view.
highlights: Classic wooden boat crossing at golden hour
Cookery evening with a local family

items.title: Paris in Golden Light
items.heroTitle: The city at its softest hour.
items.heroDescription: Three nights of early-opening museums, market mornings and a candlelit bistro table, planned around quieter streets.
items.summary: A compact city break with a private guide for one morning, a food market walk and plenty of unplanned café time.
highlights: Seine-side evening walk with a local

items.title: Dolomites Hut to Hut
items.heroDescription: Six days of gentle hut-to-hut walking beneath Tre Cime, with a mountain guide, luggage transfers and long alpine breakfasts.
items.summary: Walking days between mountain huts, with a certified guide, light packs and evenings on the terrace as the rock turns rose.
highlights: Guided hut-to-hut route beneath Tre Cime
